declarations.name: PkTableElement
declarations.description: A data table. declarations.name: PkWorkspaceElement
declarations.description: A tool page in panes: a nav pane, a main pane and an optional docked aside, each scrolling on its own. On a phone one pane shows at a time and a tab strip (Contents, Content, Details) switches it.

attributes.name: fill

attributes.name: aside-open
